mapper.insert: insert ignore into cms_registration_payment_fact (registration_id, registration_no, payment_fact_id, payment_fact_hash, transaction_id) select r.id, r.registration_no, f.id, f.fact_hash, f.transaction_id from cms_registration r join wx_verified_payment_fact f on f.id=#{factId} where r.id=#{registrationId} and cast(f.fact_hash as binary)=cast(#{factHash} as binary) and r.payment_status=2 and r.registration_status=2 and cast(r.registration_no as binary)=cast(f.business_out_trade_no as binary) and cast(r.transaction_id as binary)=cast(f.transaction_id as binary) and r.wechat_payment_amount*100=f.total_fen and f.amount_fen=f.total_fen and f.fact_kind='PAYMENT' and f.verification_outcome='VERIFIED' and f.verification_version=1 and f.verification_method='SDK_QUERY_ORIGINAL_ORDER'
mapper.select: select registration_id, registration_no, payment_fact_id, payment_fact_hash, transaction_id from cms_registration_payment_fact where registration_id=#{registrationId}
